first.rationale: Aggressive competitor entry pricing creates an immediate acquisition risk in the price-sensitive SMB segment, and inherited evidence indicates targeted promotional pricing has lifted both acquisition and revenue there. Run a segmented experiment rather than a broad discount to protect sustainable value; verify the pricing record and compare its durability against onboarding evidence before commitment.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening the onboarding flow. It directly addresses the 4% decline in completion and has verified evidence of improving completion (+13%), time-to-value (-2.1 days), and 30-day retention (+3%), supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Do not use promotional pricing: the verified discount test increased signups but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, making it unsuitable for the primary objective.
